subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode report until live current-main envelope proof identifies the first drop boundary, or fold it into broader Slack Socket Mode liveness work?
rationale: The source proves handler and filter boundaries but not the reporter's live zero-envelope failure, and the related open Socket Mode issues cover broader symptoms with different evidence.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove delivery report and ask for redacted current-main Slack envelopes, trace logs, and channel status before any code change.

options.title: Fold Into Liveness
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode liveness cluster if maintainers believe reaction events are another manifestation of stale websocket delivery.

options.title: Reopen Automation Later
options.body: Wait for live proof that identifies a specific code drop boundary, then queue a focused fix PR against that Slack plugin path.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove delivery report and ask for redacted current-main Slack envelopes, trace logs, and channel status before any code change.

likelyOwner.reason: The current item references the Slack system-event routing fix and the current reaction routing/filter code is closest to that merged work.
